entry.title: Market brief — 9 November 2026 close, carried on the 10 November holiday
entry.summary: Indian market brief in plain English: the exchanges were shut on Tuesday 10 November 2026 for Diwali-Balipratipada, so this brief carries Monday 9 November 2026's verified close — Nifty 50 25,044.65 (+58.25, +0.23%), Sensex 81,106.65 (+107.25, +0.13%) and the rupee at 93.93 per dollar — with that date attached. Bullion did print: IBJA's 10 November morning benchmark is Rs 1,42,420 per 10 g of 24K gold (+968) and Rs 1,86,000 per kg of 999 silver (+3,132).
